question: What does the woman invite her beloved to do in this chapter?
options: Go to the countryside and see if the vines have budded
Go up to Jerusalem to meet the king
Hide in the clefts of the rock
Gather the flocks at the shepherds' tents
explanation: In Song of Songs 7:11-12 she invites him to go to the countryside and see if the vines have budded and the pomegranates are in bloom.
